007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model;
008
009import java.util.Locale;
010
011/**
012 * Object-list modes currently recognized by the SDK.
013 * <p>
014 * This enum is used for creation and update validation. Existing database
015 * profile metadata may contain a newer mode and is preserved as a string
016 * during hydration.
017 *
018 * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/autonomous-database/serverless/adbsb/select-ai-manage-profiles.html">
019 *      Select AI profile object-list configuration</a>
020 */
021public enum ObjectListMode {
022    /** Let Select AI automatically choose relevant objects from metadata. */
023    AUTOMATED("automated"),
024    /** Consider all accessible objects unless constrained by object list. */
025    ALL("all");
026
027    /** Wire-format value expected by the {@code object_list_mode} profile attribute. */
028    private final String value;
029
030    ObjectListMode(String value) {
031        this.value = value;
032    }
033
034    /**
035     * Returns the value used in the JSON profile attribute payload.
036     *
037     * @return wire-format string value used in profile attributes
038     */
039    public String getValue() {
040        return value;
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * Parses an object-list mode using case-insensitive matching.
045     *
046     * @param value object-list mode supplied to a creation or update builder
047     * @return matching enum constant for input value, or {@code null} when input is null/blank
048     */
049    public static ObjectListMode fromValue(String value) {
050        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
051            return null;
052        }
053
054        String normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
055        return switch (normalized) {
056            case "automated" -> AUTOMATED;
057            case "all" -> ALL;
058            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
059                    "objectListMode must be one of: automated, all");
060        };
061    }
062}
